svg.title: Slippage Banana Co. share certificate
svg.desc: A joke share certificate of SLIPPAGE BANANA CO., printed in one ink with a red wax seal. The vignette shows a bunch of bananas on a crate, and a banana peel on the floor with skid marks next to it. Under the name it says THIS CERTIFIES NOTHING, and a sheet of five numbered coupons hangs below a perforation.
